lines.say: You understood the method on Tuesday. By the exam, it's gone.
Because you practised it the easy way. Same type, back to back.
It feels like learning. It's just repeating.
Then the exam mixes everything, and you can't tell which method to use.
So mix your sets. Old questions next to new ones.
It feels harder. That's exactly why it sticks.
Offload runs your old methods on F S R S, so they come back.
Comment mix and I'll send you the method.
